I added `restock` to `inventory.py:34`. It finds the item by sku, adds `amount` to its qty and returns the item. If no item has that sku it raises `KeyError(sku)`.

I added two tests in `test_inventory.py`. One checks that only the matching item's qty goes up. The other checks that an unknown sku raises `KeyError` and leaves every qty unchanged. Both pass.

The full suite has 5 tests and 1 fails, but not because of this change: `apply_discount` returns `price * percent / 100`, so `apply_discount(100, 10)` gives 10 instead of 90. I didn't touch it.

`change.diff` has a separate bug, also untouched: `remove_sold_out` removes items from the list while looping over it, so it misses a sold-out item that comes right after another one.

`restock` doesn't check `amount`, so a negative or non-integer value is accepted as is.
